Question: Joan of Arc - how much of her story is pure legend?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a favorite story about a superhero. Some parts of the story really happened, and some parts people added later to make it even more exciting or special.

Joan of Arc was a real girl who lived a long time ago. She helped her country in a big war. She said she heard voices from angels telling her what to do. Because of this, people thought she was very special.

But over the years, people told and retold her story. Some things people say about her are true—like she wore armor and rode horses. But other things, like some magical or super amazing things, might be stories people made up later to make her seem even more amazing.

So, some of Joan of Arc’s story really happened, but some parts are like the fun, magical parts of a fairy tale that people added later.
